shots.title: Align commit-ready CODEBASE freshness with map --check semantics (#510)
shots.notes: `slope commit-ready` now reuses `runStalenessCheck` from the map command and only warns when map-check semantics mark the map stale.

shots.title: Add historically tracked ignored CODEBASE regression for commit-ready (#510)

hazards.description: The first full-suite run timed out the new regression because it created 35 commits under suite contention. The test was tightened to use the old env threshold path and only three commits.

shots.notes: Added regression coverage for a CODEBASE.md that was historically tracked, later ignored/untracked, and locally regenerated with current frontmatter.

conditions.description: The Windows full suite continues to emit known temp-repo stderr, CRLF, and path warnings, but all tests passed after the focused regression was tightened.

training.description: Guard-adjacent commands should share the same freshness model as the command they recommend.
training.outcome: `commit-ready` now uses map-check semantics instead of old git last-touch history, so `slope map` can actually clear the warning it recommends.

nutrition.description: `corepack pnpm vitest run tests/cli/commands/commit-ready.test.ts tests/cli/commands/map.test.ts` passed: 17 tests.
`corepack pnpm typecheck` and `corepack pnpm test` passed on Windows: 229 test files passed, 1 skipped; 3623 tests passed, 25 skipped.
`slope roadmap validate` passed with existing historical roadmap warnings.
`node dist/cli/index.js commit-ready` and `node dist/cli/index.js map --check` agree that CODEBASE.md is current.

nineteenth_hole.how_did_it_feel: Small but important. The defect was exactly the kind of recovery-command mismatch this phase is supposed to flush out.
nineteenth_hole.advice_for_next_player: When two commands describe the same state, prefer one shared computation over parallel heuristics.
nineteenth_hole.what_surprised_you: A test that passed focused could still time out in the full suite because it made too many real git commits.
nineteenth_hole.excited_about_next: The release sprint can now proceed with the map freshness warning cleared in branch-built CLI output.

bunker_locations: Historically tracked but currently ignored files can still have git log history; do not treat that history as current-file freshness.
Full-suite contention can expose fixture cost hidden by focused test runs.
`slope status --sprint=143.5` currently displays S143 claims, suggesting decimal sprint parsing in the course-status command needs follow-up.
yardage_book_updates: Commit-ready warns only when map-check semantics return a stale result; warn-only map-check output remains commit-ready OK.
`tests/cli/commands/commit-ready.test.ts` covers historically tracked, ignored, regenerated CODEBASE.md maps.
course_management_notes: Validation passed: focused S143.5 tests, `corepack pnpm typecheck`, `corepack pnpm test`, `slope roadmap validate`, and branch-built `commit-ready`/`map --check` smoke checks.
Issue #510 should close when the PR containing S143.5 merges.
